Located in the heart of Ho Chi Minh City, LOTTE HOTEL SAIGON offers a five-star experience that combines luxury and convenience. With its prime location just 0.35 km from the city center, this hotel is the perfect choice for both business and leisure travelers. The hotel's close proximity to the airport, only 25 minutes away, ensures a hassle-free journey for guests. LOTTE HOTEL SAIGON boasts a total of 283 elegantly designed rooms, providing a comfortable and stylish retreat for guests. Each room is thoughtfully furnished and equipped with modern amenities to meet the needs of discerning travelers. The hotel was built in 2001 and underwent a renovation in 2014, ensuring that guests enjoy the best of both classic and contemporary design. Check-in at LOTTE HOTEL SAIGON begins at 02:00 PM, allowing guests to settle in and start their stay with ease. The check-out time is until 12:00 PM, giving guests ample time to pack up and prepare for their departure. The hotel's efficient and friendly staff are always ready to assist guests, ensuring a smooth and pleasant check-in and check-out process. Families traveling with children will find LOTTE HOTEL SAIGON to be a welcoming destination. The hotel's child policy allows children between the ages of 5 to 11 to stay free of charge, making it an ideal choice for family vacations. The hotel also offers a range of amenities and services tailored to meet the needs of young guests, ensuring a memorable and enjoyable stay for the whole family. Experience the epitome of luxury and convenience at LOTTE HOTEL SAIGON. Whether you're visiting Ho Chi Minh City for business or leisure, this five-star hotel provides the perfect base for exploring the vibrant city and enjoying a comfortable stay. Book your stay at LOTTE HOTEL SAIGON and indulge in the finest hospitality Vietnam has to offer.

Discover the Vibrant District 1 in Ho Chi Minh City

Welcome to the heart of Ho Chi Minh City, where the bustling District 1 awaits you. Known as the city's financial and commercial hub, this vibrant district is a melting pot of history, culture, and modernity. With its central location, District 1 is the perfect base for exploring all that Ho Chi Minh City has to offer. Immerse yourself in the rich history of the city with a visit to iconic landmarks such as the Notre-Dame Cathedral Basilica of Saigon and the Central Post Office, both stunning architectural masterpieces. Food lovers will be in paradise in District 1, as it is home to a wide range of culinary delights. From street food stalls serving up delicious banh mi and pho, to upscale restaurants offering exquisite Vietnamese and international cuisine, there is something to satisfy every palate. Don't forget to explore the vibrant local markets, such as Ben Thanh Market, where you can indulge in fresh produce, local handicrafts, and souvenirs. After a day of exploring, retreat to the comfort of LOTTE HOTEL SAIGON, located in the heart of District 1. With its luxurious accommodations, world-class amenities, and impeccable service, this hotel offers the perfect oasis amidst the bustling city. Whether you're here for business or leisure, LOTTE HOTEL SAIGON is the ideal choice for an unforgettable stay in Ho Chi Minh City.

Convenient Transportation from Ho Chi Minh City Airports to LOTTE HOTEL SAIGON

Welcome to LOTTE HOTEL SAIGON, a luxurious and elegant hotel located in the heart of Ho Chi Minh City's District 1. Getting to our hotel from the nearby airports is quick and hassle-free, ensuring a smooth start to your stay in this vibrant city. If you are arriving at Tan Son Nhat International Airport, the most convenient option to reach LOTTE HOTEL SAIGON is by taxi. Taxis are readily available outside the airport terminals, and the journey to the hotel takes approximately 30 minutes, depending on the traffic. Make sure to choose reputable taxi companies such as Vinasun or Mai Linh for a reliable and comfortable ride. Alternatively, if you prefer public transportation, you can take a bus from the airport to District 1. Bus number 109 operates between Tan Son Nhat International Airport and the city center, including stops near LOTTE HOTEL SAIGON. The bus runs from early morning until late at night, offering an affordable and convenient option for travelers. For those arriving at Long Thanh International Airport, which is currently under construction, the most convenient way to reach LOTTE HOTEL SAIGON is by booking a private transfer or taxi. The journey from Long Thanh International Airport to the hotel takes approximately 1 hour, depending on the traffic conditions. Whichever airport you arrive at, LOTTE HOTEL SAIGON is easily accessible, allowing you to start your visit to Ho Chi Minh City with ease and comfort. Discover the Vibrant Surroundings of LOTTE HOTEL SAIGON

Located in the heart of Ho Chi Minh City, LOTTE HOTEL SAIGON offers easy access to some of the city's most iconic landmarks and attractions. Just a short distance away, you will find the Central Post Office, a magnificent colonial building that showcases stunning architecture. This stunning building hosts a variety of performances, including ballets, concerts, and theatrical productions. Ho Chi Minh Squares, A O Show - Lune Production, Bui Vien Street, Notre Dame Square, and Golden Dragon Water Puppet Theater are also within close proximity, offering a range of entertainment options and cultural experiences. With its prime location, LOTTE HOTEL SAIGON provides the perfect base to explore these captivating landmarks and attractions, ensuring an unforgettable stay in Ho Chi Minh City.

A Vibrant Culinary Scene Just Steps Away

LOTTE HOTEL SAIGON is surrounded by an array of diverse and enticing dining options. For craft beer enthusiasts, Pasteur Street Brewing Company is a must-visit, offering a wide selection of locally brewed beers. For those craving authentic Vietnamese cuisine, Propaganda Vietnamese Bistro and Quan Nem Restaurant are perfect choices, serving up traditional dishes bursting with flavors. If you're in the mood for a cozy and charming dining experience, Cuc Gach Quan Restaurant and Den Long - Home Cooked Vietnamese Restaurant are highly recommended. For steak lovers, B3 Steakhouse & Craft Beer is the place to be, combining juicy cuts of meat with a great selection of craft beers. And for a taste of Japanese cuisine, Miyama - Modern Tokyo Restaurant Cafe is the go-to spot. Whether you're in the mood for classic Vietnamese pho or a refreshing poke bowl, Pho Quynh and Poke Saigon offer delicious options. With such a vibrant culinary scene right at your doorstep, you'll never run out of dining choices during your stay at LOTTE HOTEL SAIGON.

Fashion enthusiasts can explore Sapa, a boutique store known for its unique and ethically sourced clothing and accessories. L'usine, a chic concept store and cafe, is perfect for a mid-shopping break, serving up delicious coffee and delectable pastries. With such a variety of shopping landmarks surrounding LOTTE HOTEL SAIGON, guests are sure to have an unforgettable retail experience.
